text:
maria: Hey team — after the galactic8b rollout to canary I'm seeing a recurring trailing special token and punctuation bias. Short answers often end with '...' and a final ▁END token. Sample below.

maria: prompt: "Summarize the meeting" -> output: "We discussed roadmap priorities... ▁END"

anika: Can you paste the raw token ids and confirm which quantization path we used? qlora-4bit vs int8?

maria: This was qlora-4bit with fused kernels on the dedicated canary pool. Token ids (trimmed): [50256, 17, 198, 345, 13, 50257] — looks like an EOS-ish id at the end.

liam: Might be a tokenizer mismatch or a kv-cache alignment issue when fused kernels are active. Also check if any kernel fallbacks happened during those requests.

jordan: infra note — I'm seeing short GPU mem spikes and kernel_fallback events correlated with the timestamps. Example log snippet: `[runtime] kernel_fallback: aten_fast_gelu -> fallback_path at 2026-03-20T12:14:05Z`.

anika: Requesting repro: run the eval harness with seed=42, max_new_tokens=32, and try both fused=true/false and fp16/4bit variants. If it's systemic we'll add failing prompts to the regression suite.

maria: Repro command I used:
```
python tests/run_eval.py --model=galactic8b --quant=qlora-4bit --seed=42 --seq=64 --prompt="Summarize the meeting"
```
Result: trailing "... ▁END" observed in 37/50 runs.

liam: Ops action — can we spin a canary variant with fused=false? @deploy-bot can you route a tiny percent to fused=false and tag logs for this run?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary variant galactic8b-fused=false at rollout id r-3402 :white_check_mark:

anika: If repro holds, proposed immediate checklist: 1) Add regression test to eval harness for the failing prompts. 2) Compare tokenizer vocab & preproc used at pretraining time vs serving tokenizer. 3) Run quantization sweep (8bit, 4bit non-fused) to isolate fused-kernel interaction. 4) Consider temporary rollback to fp16 if customer impact is high.

jordan: I'll attach full GPU traces and enable verbose kernel logging for the next hour. Also checking if any recent kernel selection changes rolled in yesterday.

maria: Owners: @anika (ML triage), @liam (kernels/ops), @jordan (infra logs). Marking P1 since this hit canary and affects end-user text.

liam: I'll try a quick local repro with fused=false and qlora-4bit non-fused, ETA ~45m. Will post diffs.

anika: I'll run a mini alignment sweep across our prompt bank and add failing cases to the eval suite. I'll also add an alert rule: "END token frequency > 5% over rolling 1k requests".

maria: Thanks all — once we confirm root cause I'll draft a short postmortem and update the onboarding checklist to include a fused-kernel pass for quantized models. :thumbsup:
